response.answer:
### The Aspiring Gastronome's Refrigerator
Fictional patent sketch.

FIGURE 1
```text
[A: gleaming artisanal cheese] → [B: wilting produce drawer]
          ↑                               ↓
          └──── [C: forgotten recipe card] ────┘
```

CLAIM 1 — An apparatus that converts the intention of culinary exploration into the certainty of delivered sustenance, while ensuring the operator's pantry remains a monument to unrealized ambition.

BENCH TEST — In this imagined kitchen, the operator proudly places a block of aged cheddar into the refrigerator. The gleaming artisanal cheese, representing a planned charcuterie board, immediately triggers the wilting produce drawer to begin its slow decay. Later, the forgotten recipe card, intended for a complex vegetable tart, is found nestled beneath a half-eaten carton of pad thai. The operator sighs, then dials the local Thai restaurant.

REMOVE ONE PART
A: Lose the gleaming artisanal cheese; the fridge will hold less aspirational decay, but the impulse to buy it will remain.
B: Lose the wilting produce drawer; the vegetables might last longer, but the visual reminder of neglect is gone.
C: Lose the forgotten recipe card; the operator might stumble upon an idea, but the path to takeaway is less clearly signposted.

Try outside the sketch: before buying the next ambitious grocery item, write down the specific meal it is intended for.
